name: fintech-compliance-copy
description: Design, build, and keep regulator-safe a crypto / digital-asset / payment / fintech marketing website. Two modes: (1) build a new payment-platform site to a proven institutional design standard (dark-tech, trust-signal-heavy, not AI-generated) with compliance baked in; (2) apply a lawyer/compliance review to an existing site — remove live trading/FX/price displays, mark unlaunched services (virtual accounts, IBAN, cards, settlement rails) as not currently available, add no-advice / no-banking / not-an-endorsement disclaimers, insert legal-approved wording verbatim. Triggers: design a payment platform / crypto exchange / fintech site, apply the legal review, AUSTRAC/ASIC/AFSL/FCA/MAS/MiCA website review, de-risk the copy.
